versions.content: The multiplicity of I/O devices managed by the I/O Hardware Abstraction software shall be handled via several init functions. Each init function shall be tagged with an <Init_ID>. Therefore, an external device, having its Specification of I/O Hardware Abstraction AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 43 of 63 Document ID 47 : AUTOSAR_SWS_IOHardwareAbstraction - AUTOSAR confidential - driver encapsulated inside the I/O Hardware Abstraction, can be separately initialized.
